# Technical Background and Planning

---

**Scheduled time:** 10:15 AM–10:30 AM

## Objective

This chapter helps the assessor understand your current experience and how you plan a small full-stack project. 

The practical assessment that follows is one connected project:

> Build a Contact and Feedback application using Directus as the backend, Figma as the design specification, and React with the Directus SDK as the frontend.

## Working Rules

- You may use official documentation and ordinary web searches.
- You may use AI-assited development tools unless a task specifically states otherwise.
- You may ask the assessor to clarify a business requirement.
- Record important decisions and problems as you work.
- Existing tutorials may be used for learning.
